payload.title: Prevent one-facade import fallback from overriding competing pattern or handler bindings
payload.summary: P1 maintained RI false-positive References. With actual observed target.py defining f, facade.py importing f then binding f through MatchAs, MatchStar, MatchMapping.rest or ExceptHandler.name, corrected direct module lookup refuses unique declaration truth, but resolve_python_imported_member returns RESOLVED. references.declarations.resolution._resolve overrides the direct refusal with ONE_FACADE and emits a direct-call Reference to target.f. Real ContextTools source_relationships dispatch also exposes the incorrect target for capture and handler cases. Six independently authored source fixtures include valid plain import and refusing ordinary-assignment controls. No source fixture executed, model invoked or edit-authority bypass established.
payload.benefit: Bounded owner: one-facade imported-member resolution and its Reference fallback, separate from the delivered direct lookup/module-local/base correction. Fail closed on genuine competing bindings and preserve qualified support/reasons. Reuse the maintained non-Name binding extraction only with correct facade scope/traversal; never blindly scan nested local scopes. Acceptance: real retained-source independent regressions for simple/star/mapping-rest captures and exception aliases after facade import; unrelated/local names, unchanged sync/async facade and ordinary assignments remain correct; before/after/lifetime differences remain conservative rather than interpreted at runtime. No fallback may upgrade an authenticated competing-binding refusal into a positive Reference. Cover complete resolver-to-Reference-to-ContextTools ToolRunner composition with literal target/refusal expectations, stale/foreign inputs and stable provenance. Preserve syntactic declaration selection and edit authority. Run focused regressions, Ruff/format, strict mypy and final-tree protected 100% branch coverage before normal PR promotion.

Target-module rebinding and other unsupported forms require explicit inspection during the bounded repair, not an assertion that they are already fixed.
